title: SKYBU / SkinGPT: SCOBY-derived circular biomanufacturing concept
claim_ceiling: Bacterial cellulose is not claimed to be a validated ballistic armor replacement.
SkinGPT is not claimed to be a field-qualified armor system.
A beverage co-product is not claimed to be safe, nutritious, tonic, or regulatory-compliant without food-specific validation.
Genetically engineered material-production cultures are not proposed for direct human consumption.
Zero-waste operation is a design target, not an established result.
Acetate is an energy-relevant metabolite and industrial feedstock, not a complete substitute for human nutrition.
core_hypothesis: A modular SCOBY-derived biomanufacturing platform can be split into specialized and physically separated production lanes: bacterial-nanocellulose materials, acetate-rich chemical streams, and a conventional food-grade fermentation stream. SkinGPT can use the material lane as a bio-derived carrier for distributed sensing on robotic and uncrewed platforms.

input_classes: food-grade sugar/tea substrates for the separate beverage lane

production_lanes.SkinGPT_role: Carrier and mechanical interface for tactile, thermal, vibration, impact, and damage-awareness sensing.
production_lanes.defense_use_boundary: Protective and diagnostic material research for robotic/uncrewed platforms; no ballistic performance is claimed until standardized testing exists.

outputs: potential downstream acetate salts or chemical feedstocks after purification and process validation
production_lanes.design_goal: Treat acetate production as a useful co-product stream rather than an uncharacterized waste stream.
production_lanes.boundary: No food or medical use is inferred from industrial production alone.

production_lanes.organism_family: food-grade non-engineered kombucha culture unless separately authorized
production_lanes.design_goal: Explore a separately manufactured beverage co-product under food-grade controls.
production_lanes.boundary: Must be physically and procedurally separated from engineered-material production. Safety, composition, alcohol content, acidity, contaminants, shelf life, labeling, and regulatory compliance require independent validation before consumption or sale.

SkinGPT_integration.concept: bio-derived sensing skin for autonomous and robotic systems
SkinGPT_integration.claim_boundary: Protective-composite and armor-related use remains a testable engineering direction, not a demonstrated ballistic capability.

circularity_model.target: maximize useful co-products and minimize discarded process streams
principles: separate food and engineered-material process chains
characterize every output before assigning a use
purify chemical co-products to the requirements of their intended application
reuse biomass or process water only after contamination and compatibility testing
measure mass balance before describing the process as zero-waste

external_pitch.suggested_value_proposition: Investigate bacterial-nanocellulose-based sensing and protective composite skins for uncrewed platforms, with SkinGPT as the sensing layer and a circular biomanufacturing architecture as the manufacturing research path.
external_pitch.pitch_boundary: Present as a research collaboration proposal, not as a finished armor product or a proven zero-waste food-production system.

evidence_basis.claim_supported: Komagataeibacter can be genetically programmed to control and functionalize bacterial cellulose production.
evidence_basis.source: Florea et al., Engineering control of bacterial cellulose production using a genetic toolkit and a new cellulose-producing strain, PNAS (2016)

evidence_basis.claim_supported: Engineered K. rhaeticus has been used to grow self-pigmenting bacterial-cellulose textile prototypes.
evidence_basis.source: Walker et al., Self-pigmenting textiles grown from cellulose-producing bacteria with engineered tyrosinase expression, Nature Biotechnology

evidence_basis.claim_supported: Nanocellulose/aramid composite aerogels have been demonstrated as pressure-sensing materials.
evidence_basis.source: Wang et al., Thermal insulating, light-weight and conductive cellulose/aramid nanofibers composite aerogel for pressure sensing, Carbohydrate Polymers (2021)

evidence_basis.claim_supported: Aramid nanofibers can reinforce bacterial-cellulose membranes in composite systems.
evidence_basis.source: Yang et al., Aramid nanofiber/bacterial cellulose composite separators for lithium-ion batteries, Carbohydrate Polymers (2020)

evidence_basis.claim_supported: Acetic-acid fermentation proceeds through ethanol oxidation involving membrane-bound alcohol dehydrogenase and aldehyde dehydrogenase.
evidence_basis.source: Yakushi et al., Role of a membrane-bound aldehyde dehydrogenase complex AldFGH in acetic acid fermentation with Acetobacter pasteurianus, Applied Microbiology and Biotechnology (2018)

evidence_basis.claim_supported: Acetate can be oxidized as a metabolic fuel in humans but this does not make acetate a complete food.
evidence_basis.source: Regional acetate kinetics and oxidation in human volunteers

validation_gates: Quantify bacterial-cellulose yield and mechanical properties for each material formulation.
Measure sensor performance separately from structural performance.
Perform standardized impact, puncture, thermal, humidity, fatigue, and environmental testing before protective claims.
If ballistic protection is pursued, use appropriate certified ballistic test standards and independent laboratories.
Establish mass-balance data before making zero-waste claims.
Validate acetate purity and intended downstream specification before describing it as a useful product stream.
Keep any beverage process separate from engineered strains and perform food-safety/regulatory testing before human consumption.
next_steps: Build SkinGPT coupon prototypes on bacterial-cellulose carrier material.
Compare untreated bacterial cellulose, polymer-stabilized bacterial cellulose, and aramid-reinforced composite samples.
Record repeatable impact, bend, vibration, humidity, and thermal datasets.
Measure fermentation mass balance: feedstock input, cellulose output, acetate/acidity profile, residual sugars, ethanol, biomass, water, and discarded fraction.
Prepare a concise external research pitch to robotics and autonomous-systems manufacturers.
